rounds.text: Kkalpana Plastick Ltd exhibits a fundamental disconnect between its market valuation and its underlying operational performance. The company is currently trading at a price-to-book ratio of 4.50x [E1], yet it generates an abysmal return on equity of 0.9% and a return on capital employed of only 1.1% [E5, E6]. This inefficiency is compounded by a severe collapse in profitability, evidenced by a -118% compounded profit growth over the trailing twelve months [E10]. While the stock price has surged 112% over the past year [E14], the scanX signal engine confirms that price growth is outpacing profit growth by 230%, indicating that market expectations have become detached from the company's actual delivery [E39]. Furthermore, the lack of any dividend yield provides no income buffer for investors holding this asset [E3]. Conceded: the company has shown 29% compounded profit growth over three years [E9] and significant share price appreciation over the last decade [E11, E12, E13].
